synopsis: The standards and regulations comparison uses status information current as of 1 October 2026, with ISO document statuses taken from the ISO catalogue [f2653]. The skeptic’s review reports that the October 2026 catalogue lists new editions of ISO 19014 Parts 1–5 as under publication, being issued in October 2026 [f11164]. It reports the same timing and publication status for a new edition of ISO 21815-4 [f11165]. These entries provide specific status details, but the supplied facts do not confirm completed publication or establish whether the October catalogue entries were available at the comparison’s 1 October cutoff [f2653, f11164, f11165].
